description.en: Sets up a new project: README, .gitignore, folder layout and a first test for the chosen stack.
description.es: Prepara un proyecto nuevo: README, .gitignore, estructura de carpetas y una primera prueba para la tecnología elegida.

nodes.question: In one or two sentences, what is {{projectName}} going to do?

nodes.text:
Bootstrap this project using {{stack}}. Project goal: {{goal}}

Create: a README.md (purpose, how to install, how to run, how to test), a suitable .gitignore, a sensible folder layout (source, tests, docs) and one small first test that passes. Keep it minimal and do not add dependencies that are not needed.
